parts.name: drafted_box
parts.lesson: clean draft: moldable along +z, no side actions

parts.name: drafted_cone
parts.lesson: convex body: no undercut from any axis

parts.name: cosmetic_panel
parts.lesson: no draft on a cosmetic wall -> high draft_penalty (a finish/ejection defect) though still 0 side actions

parts.name: drafted_panel
parts.lesson: the corrected panel: 3deg draft clears the penalty

parts.name: rect_tube
parts.lesson: side through-hole: clean along the bore axis (0); one slide if drawn across it

parts.name: rect_tube_rotated
parts.lesson: off-axis bore -> bbox-6 misses the moldable axis the search recovers

parts.name: twin_parallel_undercuts
parts.lesson: two coaxial bores: one draw frees both; drawn across, a single shared slide (set-cover merge)

parts.name: two_perp_undercuts
parts.lesson: bores on perpendicular axes: aligning the draw to one needs a single slide; drawn across both, two

parts.name: tilted_tube
parts.lesson: tilted bore: clean along the bore axis; drawn upright it needs an angled lifter, not a slide

parts.name: sealed_shell
parts.lesson: fully enclosed cavity -> die-locked from every axis, needs a redesign
